```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)

# Load and Prepare Data
whr <- read_csv("Desktop/STAT 436/Group project/whr.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Process data
happiness_rank_year <- whr %>%
  rename("Happiness_Score" = "Happiness score") %>% 
  mutate(
    RankGroup = case_when(
      Rank <= 25 ~ "Top 25 happiest",
      Rank <= 50 ~ "Ranks 26–50",
      Rank <= 100 ~ "Ranks 51–100",
      TRUE ~ "Ranks 101+"
    ),
    RankGroup = factor(
      RankGroup,
      levels = c("Top 25 happiest", "Ranks 26–50", "Ranks 51–100", "Ranks 101+")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(RankGroup, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Happiness = mean(Happiness_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RankGroup))

all_years <- sort(unique(happiness_rank_year$Year))

#  Define UI 
ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("body { padding-top: 20px; }"))),
  

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Description"),
      helpText("Rank is each country’s position in the World Happiness Report (1 = most happiest)."),
      helpText("Line = average happiness by rank."),
      hr(),
      h4("Instructions"),
      helpText("Click on a line in the graph to highlight it."), 
      helpText("Click 'Reset View' or empty space to show all."),
      br(),
      actionButton("reset_btn", "Reset View", icon = icon("refresh"), class = "btn-primary"),
      hr(),
      verbatimTextOutput("click_info")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("trend_plot", click = "plot_click", height = "600px")
    )
  )
)

#  Define Server 
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Custom colors
  custom_colors <- c(
    "Top 25 happiest" = "purple4",
    "Ranks 26–50"     = "#D8BFD8", 
    "Ranks 51–100"    = "#C71585",
    "Ranks 101+"      = "lightpink"
  )
  
  selected_group <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  observeEvent(input$plot_click, {
    clicked <- nearPoints(happiness_rank_year, input$plot_click, xvar = "Year", yvar = "Avg_Happiness", threshold = 10, maxpoints = 1)
    if (nrow(clicked) > 0) selected_group(as.character(clicked$RankGroup))
    else selected_group(NULL)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$reset_btn, { selected_group(NULL) })
  
  output$trend_plot <- renderPlot({
    highlight <- selected_group()
    
    # Base Plot
    p <- ggplot(happiness_rank_year, aes(x = Year, y = Avg_Happiness, group = RankGroup)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_years) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(3, 8)) + 
      labs(
        x = NULL, 
        y = "Average Happiness Score", 
        title = "Happiness Trends by Rank Groups Over Time",
        subtitle = NULL 
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
  
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
  
    if (is.null(highlight)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_line(aes(color = RankGroup), linewidth = 1.2) +
        geom_point(aes(color = RankGroup), size = 3) +
        scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors)
    } else {
      bg_data <- happiness_rank_year %>% filter(RankGroup != highlight)
      fg_data <- happiness_rank_year %>% filter(RankGroup == highlight)
      
      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = bg_data, color = "grey85", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
        geom_point(data = bg_data, color = "grey85", size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
        geom_line(data = fg_data, aes(color = RankGroup), linewidth = 1.5) +
        geom_point(data = fg_data, aes(color = RankGroup), size = 4) +
        scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, drop = FALSE)
    }
    return(p)
  })
  
  output$click_info <- renderPrint({
    if (is.null(selected_group())) {
      cat("Showing all groups.")
    } else {
      cat(paste("Currently Focused:", selected_group()))
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
